raw_sections.summary: Profile Investment Operations and Middle Office Analyst with experience supporting Fixed Income, Cash Bonds, OTC Derivatives, Equity Swaps and global trade lifecycle operations. Skilled in excep- tion monitoring, investigation and resolution of operational breaks, data validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis and control reporting. Experienced in analysing trade data, investigating dis- crepancies, managing workflow exceptions and coordinating with Operations, Technology, Trading, Sales, Documentation teams, custodians and external stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of operational issues. raw_sections.experience:
Experience Operations Analyst | Morgan Stanley
Jun 2025 – Apr 2026
Supported post-trade lifecycle activities for global Equity Swaps and OTC Derivatives, ensuring timely settlement and accurate operational processing.
Analysed trade information, booking records and settlement data to investigate operational exceptions and support efficient issue resolution.
Produced daily MIS reports, operational dashboards and management reports using Microsoft Excel for business monitoring and decision support.
Maintained operational trackers, ageing reports and workflow monitoring tools to improve visi- bility of outstanding trade events.
Performed cash and stock reconciliations, identifying discrepancies and coordinating with Front Office, Middle Office, Technology teams, brokers and custodians.
Assisted in investigating settlement breaks, booking issues and lifecycle events while ensuring compliance with operational controls.
Prepared operational presentations and reporting packs highlighting key metrics, risks and process improvements.
Supported process improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues and recommending workflow enhancements.
Maintained process documentation, issue logs and audit evidence to support governance and operational excellence.
Operations Analyst | Nomura
May 2024 – Feb 2025
Supported Fixed Income and Bond Sales Middle Office operations, managing trade lifecycle activities including trade capture, booking validation, matching, affirmation, confirmation and settlement.
Worked with Cash Bonds and Fixed Income products, validating trade information and ensuring accurate processing across operational systems.
Investigated unmatched trades, booking discrepancies, settlement breaks and confirmation ex- ceptions through detailed analysis of trade records and operational data.
• Performed trade validation against confirmations, trade recaps and system records to identify
discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
Executed non-economic amendments, book transfers, accrual adjustments and trade split ac-tivities based on approved business instructions.
Maintained and validated static data including account information and operational reference data required for accurate trade processing.
Monitored post-trade activities and ensured timely resolution of exceptions within contractual settlement timelines.
Investigated CTM exceptions, PSET mismatches and trade workflow issues, coordinating with relevant teams for remediation.
Supported operational controls by maintaining documentation, evidence records and process adherence for audit readiness.
Produced daily MI reports, exception reports and operational metrics using Microsoft Excel, including tracking of volumes, ageing and outstanding issues.
Collaborated with Sales, Trading, Middle Office, Operations teams, brokers and custodians to resolve trade and settlement issues.
Performed reconciliation activities to ensure accuracy of trade, cash and settlement records.
